responses.text: {Male PC} You here to fight in the arena? Then you're talking to the right man.
{Female PC} What do you want from me, woman? I'm in charge of the arena, not the cooking pots.
As expected, it wasn't much of a fight, but what can you expect from slaves?
A good fight. Some NCR troopers can be competent fighters.
Unbelievable. You stood against a Ranger in single combat and survived.
{Caesar dead} {KAI-zar} Caesar was a great man, but the Legion will become even greater with Legate Lanius at its head.
{Caesar cured, Male PC} You've done the Legion a great service by healing whatever was wrong with {KAI-zar} Caesar.
{Caesar cured, Female PC} {contempt} A woman actually proved useful for once. {KAI-zar} Caesar was bold to put his life in your hands.
What do you need from me?
A great warrior. When he was but a recruit, I watched him kill ten men in the arena with his bare hands.
He doesn't feel pain and he never, ever shows mercy. If all Legionaries were like him, the Legion would be invincible.

topics.prompt: What can you tell me about the Legate?

responses.text: {Male PC} It's not something we like to speak of. The Burned Man was our greatest warrior, even greater than Legate Lanius, but he failed {KAI-zar} Caesar at the Dam.
He's been dead for several years now, but the rumor is that {KAI-zar} Caesar has scouts out looking for him all the same. The Burned Man was a very tough man.
{Female PC} Ask someone else, woman.

topics.prompt: What do you know about the Burned Man?

responses.text: {player said something dumb} No, imbecile, that's not how it works. I set up the fights, then you go in the arena and fight.
Such as?

topics.prompt: Tell me more about the arena.

responses.text: {Female PC} Women are beneath notice, as {KAI-zar} Caesar has taught us. I'm only allowing you to speak to me because you are {KAI-zar's} Caesar's guest.
I may yet, if {KAI-zar} Caesar commands it.

topics.prompt: Do you have a problem with women?

responses.text: Go.
Like what?

topics.prompt: That's enough about the arena. Let's talk about something else.

responses.text: Light armor and machetes only. The challenger - the one who asks to enter the arena - may be pitted against one or more opponents.
All matches continue until one side is dead. No exceptions.
Most of the time it's some young Legionary trying to make a name for himself, hoping to get noticed by Caesar or the Praetorians.
We pit slaves or prisoners against each other once in awhile, but it's not much of a show. They're usually too reluctant to kill each other.
I set up the fights, keep track of prisoners available, and make sure the arena's cleaned up.
{Player is a woman} Know your place, woman. Unlike the Profligates of the NCR, only {emphasis "men"} men fight in the Legion.
{Player has companion} Only you may enter. Tell your companion to wait and speak to me again.
That can be arranged. You will be facing off against a couple of disobedient slaves - not much of challenge, but it might be entertaining to watch.
There's a captured NCR trooper available - Sergeant Andrews. He's already been challenged once and survived, so he should be a worthy opponent.
I have a dangerous one for you - an NCR Ranger by the name of Stella. We got lucky, since we rarely capture Rangers alive.
Even though she's a woman, she's killed every man who's faced her in the arena, even one of the elite Centurions. With her bare hands.
Sorry, but there's nobody left who'd even be a challenge for you.

topics.prompt: I'd like to fight in the arena.

responses.text: Remember the rules: light armor and machetes only. And, of course, to the death.
Good luck.
Very well.

topics.prompt: I need some time to prepare.

responses.text: All right. Did you want something else?
Careful in there - he's tougher than he looks.
Watch out for her - she's one of the deadliest fighters I've ever seen.
Go.
